contract: cancel_scan flags a running library scan for cancellation: admin only; a call from an unauthenticated or non-admin socket does nothing (the running scan completes normally and moves libraries.lastScan); a call for a library that is not scanning sets no cancel flag (a following scan completes normally); cancelling a running scan finishes its task with 'Task canceled by user', does not move libraries.lastScan and stops before all pending items are added; repeated cancels cancel the scan once.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
force is not applicable: cancel_scan has no force or override mode.
